prompts.title: Canvas and Samuri
prompts.prompt_description: This prompt is a high-concept visual fusion that completely rebuilds a random character out of the specific DNA of a famous art style. Instead of just slapping a character onto a famous background, the subject's entire form, textures, and shading are seamlessly woven into the iconic color palette and brushstroke techniques of a master artist.
prompts.full_prompt_content: A stunning fusion of character and art style. The subject is [Insert Character/Subject - e.g., Spider-Man, Iron Man], completely reimagined and rendered entirely in the iconic artistic style of [Insert Art Style/Masterpiece - e.g., Starry Night, Mona Lisa]. The visual elements, color palette, brushstrokes, and textures of the artwork must seamlessly blend with the character's design. High resolution, creative masterpiece, unique concept art

prompts.title: Mala Hotpot
prompts.full_prompt_content: Top-down flat lay food photography of a vibrant Chinese Shabu-Shabu or Mala Hot Pot feast spread across a light wooden table. In the center, a large stainless steel split pot filled with two types of simmering broths: a fiery red spicy mala broth with star anise on one side, and a clear, golden herbal broth with shiitake mushrooms on the other. Densely surrounding the central pot are numerous square plastic trays in alternating bright red and black colors. The trays showcase an abundant variety of raw ingredients: thinly sliced marbled beef, rolled pork belly, raw minced meat topped with egg yolks, fresh mussels, crab sticks, fish balls, enoki mushrooms, glass noodles, and green leafy vegetables. Clean, bright, and even studio lighting that accentuates the fresh textures and rich colors of the ingredients. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, commercial food styling look.

prompts.title: Asian Hotpot
prompts.full_prompt_content: Professional food photography of a large, bubbling Asian hot pot or shabu-shabu feast, eye-level shot. A massive black metal pot sits in the center on a portable stove with visible glowing orange flames underneath. Inside the pot, a rich, simmering dark broth is divided, packed with thinly sliced beef, pork, broccoli florets, mushrooms, green onions, and fresh vegetables, with thick white steam rising dramatically from the center. Surrounding the main pot on a dark surface are numerous small black bowls filled with side dishes, dipping sauces, raw garlic bulbs, sliced chilies, and fresh greens. Dark background, dramatic and intense studio lighting focusing on the rising steam and the fiery glow under the pot. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, highly detailed, commercial food styling.

prompts.title: Autumn Mist at Twilight
prompts.prompt_description:
This prompt blends the raw, visible texture of Western Impressionism with the moody lighting and precise composition of early 20th-century Japanese Shin-Hanga woodblock prints.
The visual core is built on a striking complementary contrast: a dominant, cool background of teal, turquoise, and mint green pierced by sharp, warm pops of autumnal orange and rust. The texture feels like a 
rainy day—misty, soft, and damp—with fluid watercolor washes blending into thick oil strokes, all reflecting beautifully off a wet, glossy ground to create a deeply nostalgic, serene atmosphere.
prompts.full_prompt_content: An impressionistic watercolor and oil painting of [INSERT YOUR SCENE HERE]. Traditional Japanese Shin-Hanga art style, vintage Ukiyo-e aesthetic. Vibrant teal, turquoise, and mint green color palette contrasted with warm autumnal orange and rust tones. Soft textured brushstrokes, wet-on-wet watercolor washes, misty atmosphere, reflective wet ground, highly detailed, serene and nostalgic mood. --ar 3:4
